title: What did you try with AI in your game and go back to doing by hand?
author: KasperzackGames
selftext:
For me it was music. I made seven AI tracks for my game, then compared them with tracks by human composers and took all seven out. The art is still AI.

What was it for you?

comments.author: SimonPdv
comments.body: Sound design in general. It's always beep beep boop and I have no solution

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: animations. always. and balancing. and saying stop.

replies.author: KasperzackGames
replies.body: What AI tools have you tried for animations that worked at least somewhat? I'm curious about both 2D and 3D, even if they still need manual work.

comments.author: GigaTerra
comments.body:
On the AI sound topic, I am trying to generate voices using Neural Networks and Formant Synthesis. It is so frustrating difficult that my AI after an whole week (52 hours) are still just squealing NPCs.

AI and sound, isn't an easy mix.

replies.author: KasperzackGames
replies.body: For voices, ElevenLabs is actually really strong, especially v4. Definitely worth checking out if you're struggling with NPC voices.

replies.author: GigaTerra
replies.body: I will definitely give it an look. My original intent was to create procedural voices, but the task is turning into too much of an distraction. I think this is one of those times to look for an pre-made solution.

comments.author: theEsel01
comments.body: But it will all be saved in n years, sone one in these comments in 3, 2, 1

comments.author: i_rate_slop
comments.body: I just buy my sounds. You can get whole packs for like $20. Worth it just to have a good baseline and when AI sound design gets better, I’ll revisit.

replies.author: KasperzackGames
replies.body: Or look for CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA sounds. The catch is you can't always verify whether the uploader actually had the rights to license them.

comments.author: Denaton_
comments.body: I let AI do the rough job and then I polish

comments.author: Need300dollars
comments.body: Why not use Elevenslab AI or Ludo.ai for sfx?
